narrative: Across 12 SKUs, XGBoost achieves the lowest average WAPE (15.6%), winning on 5 of 12 products. It cuts the naive 28-day moving-average error by 56%. SARIMA remains competitive on stable, strongly-weekly SKUs, while tree ensembles absorb promo/price/calendar interactions the statistical baselines cannot see — which is why the selected model feeds the procurement recommendation inputs.
